literal_meaning: দেখা এবং ভালো করা (to see and do well)
figurative_meaning_bn: অনুসন্ধান করা; উত্তমরূপে দেখা; তত্ত্বাবধান করা
figurative_meaning_en: To inquire; to look after properly; to supervise or take care of
example_sentences_in_english: We need to look after the project.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali familial and communal responsibility.
